Position Description:

Company Profile:
Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end-to-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.
Job Title: Gen AI Engineer
Position: Software Engineer
Experience: 6- 8 Years
Category: Software Development/ Engineering
Shift: Timing/rotation etc. details
Main location: India, Karnataka, Bangalore
Position ID: J0726-1591
Employment Type: Full Time
Education Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field or higher with minimum 5 years of relevant experience.
Position Description: AI Engineer to join the Identity and Access Management team in Bangalore. In this role, you will bridge the gap between data science and software engineering, designing, building, and deploying scalable artificial intelligence models and applications. From optimizing classic machine learning algorithms to integrating modern Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), your work will directly drive innovation and power the intelligent features of our core products.
Responsibilities:
Key Responsibilities
Model Development Tuning: Design, build, and train robust machine learning and deep learning models to solve complex business problems.
Generative AI Agentic Workflows: Implement, fine tune, and deploy foundation models (LLMs, computer vision, or NLP). Build retrieval augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and multi agent AI systems.
Data Engineering Support: Clean, preprocess, and optimize structured and unstructured datasets for training pipelines.
Collaboration Integration: Work closely with software engineers, data scientists, and product managers to seamlessly integrate AI capabilities into our user facing applications.
Performance Optimization: Benchmark and optimize models for latency, cost, scalability, and inference speed in production environments.
Ethical AI Practice: Maintain high standards for data privacy, model bias detection, and explainable AI solutions.
Technical Documentation: Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and research summaries to justify engineering decisions with measurable value.

Must-Have Skills:
Prompt Engineering: Expertise in Prompt Engineering techniques to maximize model performance and consistency.
AI/ML Frameworks: Deep experience with frameworks.
Generative AI Tooling: Hands on experience with modern AI orchestration tools like LangChain. Solid understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP) for securely connecting LLMs to data sources and development tools.
Cloud Infrastructure: Familiarity with deploying AI applications on cloud platforms like AWS, Google Cloud (Vertex AI).
Good-to-Have Skills:
Cloud Infrastructure: Familiarity with deploying AI applications on cloud platforms like AWS, Google Cloud (Vertex AI
